g.text: SR-H/I/S/E -> local ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source and native gates OPEN

text.tspan: root-producers
Initial active credits cover each root walker before
its first idle; p0-only VM/symbol/RC paths and all-
processor frame/register/global paths have different
coverage
private-copy
Forwarding can precede full payload copy; winner
retains active credit through private alloc cursor,
inline tail and captured-frame copying
chunk-publication
Private incomplete chunk need not enter FIFO; complete
chunk publishes marker/link before visible tail;
producer stays active through synchronous call
dequeue-and-scan
Dequeued chunk and still node remain scanner-frame
custody until body/children/cursor advance complete;
new private work requires local rescan
zero-and-return
Count zero observed under termination mutex closes
covered work; waiters check zero before reacquiring
credit; payload closure differs from all callback
returns
counted-root-closure
Freeze root/participant membership; close each root
producer only after all admitted root slots seed
accounted work; complete census remains separate from
queue closure
active-custody
A counted synchronous owner covers forwarding-visible
copies, private initialized chunks and pending cursor
writes; cannot go idle or exit with any such debt
publication-handoff
Body/marker/link precede tail publication; source
covers until queue acceptance or local scan, active
thief owns after dequeue; parent completion never
drops derived work
strong-receipt
Zero count plus complete ownership/root coverage and
same-epoch synchronization permits strong-closure
receipt; no new root/publication after terminal zero
barrier-reuse
Returned worker may classify from certified closure
before peers return; existing barrier waits for every
classification; receipt does not authorize
PSTATE/queue retirement
scan-count
Existing counted-producer model distinguishes a
detached-publisher fault control; new idle obligations
refine private copy/cursor/frame coverage
work-closure
Existing canonical work/copy/publication composition
is linked to active-owner coverage; one symbolic
object does not prove actual chunk layout
callback-boundary
Existing model assumes callback return and separately
aggregates users; payload closure must not be
substituted for its return premise
reuse-rendezvous
Zero extra barrier only after strong-return closure is
qualified; local emptiness is insufficient
reuse-worker-credit
No extra runtime counter is implied by proof state;
detached producers require credit handoff or separate
tracking
preserve-boundaries
Correctness foundation rather than proven GC speedup;
root omissions and native memory-order gaps still
prevent full qualification
